limitations: Diagnostics can localize sensitivity but cannot determine a unique instrument/extraction mechanism, establish physical frequency drift, or test 1/log^2 cosmic time. All 17 exposures see the same absorber; shared coadd-derived template prevents independent confirmation.
pixel_phase_note: Fractional detector coordinate at fixed template v=0, separately for each order and trace. Both sine and cosine enter together; integer native pixel index is not itself a subpixel phase. This single reference does not describe all blended component phases.
